main_text.p: prà ex Eusebio & Hieronymo difficultatem, & instantias quasdam alias, expediamus.
main_text.head: CAPUT VIII.

p.i: Exceptiones de ancipiti Latinorum mente. Loca ex Eusebio, Hieronymo, Augustino, Philastrio, Isidoro, Rabano. De Caio. de Tertulliano. de Hippolyto. de Cypriano. de Hieronymo. De Commentatoribus in tredecim tantum Epistolas. Cardin. Baronij mala fides. Ejusdem in Eusebium, & Hieronymum iniquitas. Rei accuratius examen. Tempus motae hujus inter Latinos controversiae. Occasiones variae ostensae. Ante Hieronymum Epistola Pauli habita. Assertiones Erasmi, Ludov. Vives, Rhenani, Cameronis, &c. confutatae. Instantiae omnes aliae excussae. Qui ex Latinis in Epistolam commentati.

main_text.p: I. Esto ergo gravis illa, nec contemnenda exceptio. Frustra ut communem Latinorum sententiam obtrudi, quae diutissime prioribus etiam saeculis, sive in Romana sive Africana Ecclesia contro-versia,

page.notes: The first line of the text is a fragment continuing from the previous page and is kept as such. The page number 133 is printed top right. The running head "ad Hebraeos." is printed centred at top. Two lines at the foot ("13" with "versa") are read as a gathering signature and catchword. The word "versa" at the foot is a catchword and is not repeated in the text; the last full line ends with "controversia" broken as "contro-" at the line end, the second half "versia" appearing as the catchword. Some letters in the scan are uncertain, including "Cameronis" and "Assertiones", transcribed as seen. Printed text "prà" in the first line is read as printed; Latin spelling is kept, e.g. "Ejusdem", "tantum", "Cyprianno" read as "Cypriano".
